name: Moldy Tome
summary: A half of the Tome of the Cabal lies ruined on the Hillsbrad coast. Salvaged from a shipwreck, the Moldy Tome holds dark rituals sought by warlocks who study demonic summoning.

sections.title: Lost to the Waves
sections.body: The Tome of the Cabal was a rare work of dark arts held in Lordaeron. At some point, it was vandalized and torn in two. One half, now called the Moldy Tome, traveled by ship south toward Menethil Harbor and Ironforge. The vessel never arrived. It sank in the dangerous waters west of Southshore, and the surviving half washed ashore south of Azurelode Mine. Damp and surf ruined its pages, while murlocs scavenged along the Hillsbrad coast.

sections.title: Reclaiming the Dark Work
sections.body: The Moldy Tome still holds powerful lore about demons, though its vellum is mildewed and rotting. Warlocks seeking it brave the coastal camps. In Ironforge, Krom Stoutarm guides some of them; in the Undercity, Jorah Annison guides others. Joined with its counterpart, the Tattered Manuscript from the caves of Thousand Needles, the restored book gives the precise words needed to summon and bind a felhunter.

faq.answer: The Moldy Tome is half of the rare Tome of the Cabal, a dark book of rituals for summoning demons. Waterlogged and decayed, it is the half lost in a shipwreck.

faq.q: Where did the Moldy Tome end up?
faq.answer: The Moldy Tome washed ashore in Hillsbrad Foothills, west of Southshore and south of Azurelode Mine. Coastal murlocs keep it in their encampment.

faq.q: Why was the tome on a ship?
aliases: why was it lost at sea
faq.answer: The Moldy Tome was carried by ship from Lordaeron toward Menethil Harbor, bound for Ironforge scholars. The ship sank off the Hillsbrad coast before completing the voyage.

faq.q: What is needed to complete the Tome of the Cabal?
faq.answer: The Tome of the Cabal is completed by joining the Moldy Tome with the Tattered Manuscript, its other half. The manuscript ended up at Splithoof Hold in Thousand Needles.

angles.text: As a warlock, you seek the Moldy Tome to help recover the rituals needed to command a felhunter.
